:::{#cor-sample-mean-consistent}
#### The sample mean is consistent

Let $\dsn{X}$ be independent with common mean $\mean$ and common finite variance $\varpar$.
Then the sample mean is a [consistent](#def-consistent) estimator of $\mean$:
$\bar X_n \inprob \mean$.

:::

::: proof

By [the example on two estimators of a mean](estimation.qmd#exm-mse-sample-mean), $\pMSE{\bar X_n} = \varpar / n$,
which goes to zero as $n \to \infty$.
@thm-mse-consistent then gives $\bar X_n \inprob \mean$.
This is the
[weak law of large numbers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/limit-theorems.html#thm-wlln),
proved in pds directly from Chebyshev's inequality.

:::
